what: Publisher plan under-specifies the absolute-to-relative path algorithm for plan-review artifacts
scenario_or_breakage: Current publisher find calls are rooted at DESIGN_TMPDIR or resolved subdirs; a literal match against plan-review/round-*/findings-classification.tsv will not match absolute find output, and enumerating only the allowed glob would not see disallowed files to reject
suggested_fix: Spell out the exact loop: resolve pr_root, find all regular files under it, derive rel relative to pr_root, allow only rel matching round-<positive-int>/findings-classification.tsv, stage to $RUN_DEST/plan-review/$rel, and larch_err plus emit_publish_result false for every other regular file

what: The plan changes scripts/design-log-publish.sh but omits its sibling contract update
scenario_or_breakage: scripts/design-log-publish.md would still say design publish copies only top-level files plus render-cache and would not document the new strict plan-review allowlist; future publisher edits could follow the stale default-allow contract
suggested_fix: Add an UPDATED scripts/design-log-publish.md section documenting the plan-review/round-<N>/findings-classification.tsv staging path, reject-on-unexpected behavior, empty plan-review directory success semantics, and test coverage

what: The testing plan does not lock the plan-review exists-but-empty case
scenario_or_breakage: A set -e implementation using grep or other no-match-sensitive filtering could emit PUBLISH_OK=false when plan-review/ exists with no round directories, and the planned harness additions would not catch it
suggested_fix: Add a test-design-log-publish.sh case that creates an empty plan-review directory, and preferably an empty plan-review/round-1 directory, then asserts publish succeeds and stages no plan-review files while still rejecting a later unexpected regular file
